verdict: Lead volume fell sharply this week as ad spend dropped significantly.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 130 leads at a cost per lead of $19.85 — a solid overall figure. However, the last 7 days tell a different story: leads fell 50% and cost per lead rose 29% compared to the prior 7-day period, driven by a 47% cut in Google Ads spend that brought daily ad spend down to roughly $17.50 in the most recent three days versus $98 in the three days before. This is a spend pacing issue, not a creative or audience problem — the underlying cost efficiency remains intact when budget is flowing. Google Ads conversion tracking is also being repaired, as the top search campaign ran the full 28 days without recording a conversion in the system; that under-reporting will be resolved as part of the full stack re-test scheduled for August 31. Once spend is restored to full pacing and tracking is confirmed, you should expect lead volume to recover toward the 28-day run rate.
